name: Barney: On Location - All Around Town
storyline:
This game is based on the American television show Barney & Friends, starring the titular anthropomorphic purple dinosaur. The players can explore the world with not only Barney, but with BJ and Baby Bop, accessing locales from the show such as the bakery.

It is also possible to play twelve different mini-games and activities which are complete with lots of magical surprises in store for the player.
summary: Barney On Location - All Around Town is a PC game that was released on July 10, 2000 by Hasbro Interactive.
